url.note: the dashboard's public https origin (the cloudflared tunnel in front of strands-cad-dashboard :8099)

secret.name: STRANDS_CAD_TINY_TOKEN
secret.note: a long-lived service JWT minted by the dashboard's auth store (scope session, sub service:tiny)
prints (and caches in .strands_cad_auth.json) the service token — run in the dashboard's checkout/venv on the host

contract.chat: POST /api/chat {prompt} → {result, reply, tools[], errors[], gates[], preview}; a print request ends at an OPERATOR GATE the owner answers on the dashboard — the reply says so and carries the preview URL (80 s budget)
contract.telemetry: GET /api/telemetry → nested snapshot + flat keys job/state/progress_pct/remaining_min/nozzle_c/bed_c/chamber_c (MQTT cache, instant)
contract.snapshot: GET /api/camera/snapshot → one image/jpeg from the chamber camera
contract.stop: POST /api/stop → stops the running print (safe direction; never starts one)
contract.gate: POST /api/gate/{id} {approve:false} may be sent with the service token (deny only); approving needs a passkey session on https://printer.cagatay.my
